Missing-unit announcement: reconstructed native control flow
===========================================================

Binary sources are the two configured native Windows images. The extraction
tool reads PE bytes and unwind ownership and retains each complete owner, all
text operands, branches and calls. It does not execute a game or translation.

Steam/reference PE:6a70a6d9:02711000
  complete producer: 0x140e39910..0x140e3fde8
  relevant incident iteration: 0x140e39e9c..0x140e3a0ec
  name supplier: 0x1413e5a90..0x1413e5b1c
  full unit formatter: 0x141330c30..0x1413312b8
  announcement submission: 0x140e3a0a0 -> 0x1400e3c20

Official/classic PE:6a70b91c:0270a000
  complete producer: 0x140e34880..0x140e3ad58
  relevant incident iteration: 0x140e34e0c..0x140e3505c
  name supplier: 0x1413e0a00..0x1413e0a8c
  full unit formatter: 0x14132bba0..0x14132c228
  announcement submission: 0x140e35010 -> 0x1400e3bb0

The full producer also handles other fortress events. Its entire function is
retained rather than treating the literal's immediate neighborhood as its
ownership boundary. The missing production itself has the following gates
and two complete text forms, identical in both editions.

Reconstructed relevant producer (field names from local df.incident.xml;
native offsets and thresholds come from the retained instructions):

  if (current_year_tick % 100 != 60): skip missing pass
  for incident in world.incidents.all:
    if (incident.site [+0xd4] != current_site): continue
    if (incident.entity [+0xe0] != fortress_entity): continue
    if (incident.type [+0x4] != 0): continue
    if (incident.flags [+0xec] & 1): continue
    year_delta = current_year - incident.event_year [+0xe4]
    if (year_delta < 0): continue
    elapsed = current_year_tick - incident.event_time [+0xe8]
    if (year_delta == 1): elapsed += 0x62700
    if (year_delta < 2 && elapsed < 0x20d0): continue
    incident.flags |= 1
    victim = lookup_unit(incident.victim [+0x28])
    if (!victim): continue                         // no text submitted
    name = selected_language_name(victim)
    text = (!name || !name.has_name [+0x72]) ? "The " : ""
    text += format_full_unit(victim, mode=0)
    text += " has been missing for a week."
    category = (victim.flags1 [+0x110] & 0x04000000) ? 0x98 : 0x97
    submit(text, category, color=5, bright=1, duration=0x7d0)

The native threshold 0x20d0 is 8400 ticks (one week). The category branch changes
announcement metadata only. It does not add another sentence or a distinct
pet/citizen wording. No longer-duration phrase is authored in this production.

has_name branch ownership:
  reference 0x140e39ff3 retrieves the selected name;
            0x140e39ffb/0x140e3a001 choose the article;
            0x140e3a003 appends "The ";
            0x140e3a023 formats the actor, r8d=0;
            0x140e3a03b loads the common predicate.
  classic   0x140e34f63 retrieves the selected name;
            0x140e34f6b/0x140e34f71 choose the article;
            0x140e34f73 appends "The ";
            0x140e34f93 formats the actor, r8d=0;
            0x140e34fab loads the common predicate.

Complete authored text forms:
  has_name != 0: <full unit> has been missing for a week.
  absent name or has_name == 0: The <full unit> has been missing for a week.

The actor is not an arbitrary personal-name capture. The name getter first
follows the historical figure's current identity, including an associated
historical figure when present; it falls back to that figure's language_name
or the unit's own name. The full formatter retains this identity selection,
the native name visibility/quoted-name branches, the comma and profession or
office, and animal training status. Its mode=0 disables the optional gender
suffix at reference 0x141330eb2 / classic 0x14132be22. The complete formatter
and getter bodies are retained in the actor-format and actor-name .asm files;
their subformatters are already owned by the existing native unit identity
translation path.

Translation data:
  Both full forms use fortress-announcement [$unit] rules, with the actor
  translated through the existing unit identity path and the predicate
  translated as "已经失踪一周。". This covers generated names, profession/office,
  unnamed creatures and native identity forms without adding a particular
  screenshot person's name to a special alias list.
  The existing adventure-announcements catalogue also retains both full
  sentence forms. Runtime translations.tsv contains both the scoped rule and
  the ordinary complete-sentence record; installed dictionaries receive the
  same records in place. No dictionary generator or compilation is involved.

The separate death constructor and its cause switches are retained in the
death-* files in this directory. They are separate authored production paths,
not suffixes inferred from this missing announcement.
